articles.title: Dutch central bank shifts billions in gold from US to Britain in ‘crisis preparedness’ move - CNN
articles.description: The Dutch central bank announced Wednesday that it has moved billions of dollars worth of its gold reserves out of North America in a move it described as “crisis preparedness” in a time of global political unrest.
